steps.code:
Cloudflare dashboard → the frostaura.net zone → Workers Routes
  each endgame-outage route (endgame.<zone>/* and *.<zone>/*)
  request-limit failure mode → fail open

Cloudflare dashboard → Notifications → Add
  Tunnel Health Alert, for the tunnel cloudflared runs
steps.note: ARCH-007 step 8. Fail open means that past the Free plan's 100,000 Worker requests a day, visitors bypass the outage page instead of seeing error 1027. The alert tells the founder when the machine drops off. Neither is set through the API.
